entities.summary: Talikoti also Talikot is a taluq in Vijaypur district in the northern part of the Indian state of Karnataka, about 85 kilometres to the southeast of Vijayapura city. Next heir of the place is Harsh Talikoti. It lies on the river called Doni. It is famous for the Battle of Talikota in 1565.
